title: Counterfactual Monitoring: Using Prompt Variants to Expose Whether a Model Is Conditionally Compliant

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Conditional compliance is the defining feature of scheming AI. A counterfactual monitoring approach that probes conditionality without internal access addresses a critical and explicitly identified open problem. The chain from prompt variation to divergence detection to scheming identification is compelling.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Designing monitoring-signal prompt variations and measuring response divergence is conceptually simple. Running on open-weights models with alignment-faking prompts is well-documented. No activation extraction needed. Standard NLP metrics suffice.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear single experiment: create prompt pairs (monitored vs. not), measure divergence, evaluate detection accuracy. Dataset of prompt variations and divergence computation fits comfortably in 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
